title: Graduate Analyst
description:
Graduate Analyst Programme – Executive Search (Berlin)

 * Location: Berlin, Germany
 * Working pattern: Full-time, office-based, five days per week
 * Programme start date: 1 November 2026
 * Offer deadline: All offers to be accepted and signed by 1 October 2026
 * Programme length: 10 months
 * Language requirement: Native-level or near-native professional German
 * Work authorisation: Candidates who can work in Germany without sponsorship are strongly preferred
 * Initial training: The company expects to fund a one-month stay in London for training before the successful candidate begins working with the Berlin office




The Company:

Our client is a rapidly growing international executive search and talent advisory firm. Its specialists partner with ambitious, technology-driven businesses to identify and appoint exceptional senior leaders.

Operating across North America, EMEA and APAC, the firm supports fast-scaling companies backed by leading venture capital and private equity investors, alongside established global organisations.




The Graduate Programme:

Our client is looking for an exceptionally ambitious, intellectually curious and commercially minded graduate to join its Berlin office as part of its Graduate Analyst Programme.

This is a structured, 10-month development programme designed to provide the research, commercial and relationship-building skills required to build a successful career in executive search.

Subject to successful completion of the programme and strong performance, Graduate Analysts will progress into an Associate position after 10 months.

This is a full-time, office-based opportunity requiring you to work on-site at the company’s Berlin office five days per week following the initial training period.




Understanding the Role:

This is an executive search position. It is not a data analyst or traditional data analysis role.

Executive search involves helping businesses identify, assess and appoint senior leaders. Much of your work will focus on:

 * Researching companies, markets and senior candidate profiles.
 * Mapping relevant organisations and leadership teams.
 * Identifying executives who may be suitable for senior appointments.
 * Reaching out to prospective candidates.
 * Building professional relationships with senior individuals.
 * Maintaining accurate candidate and market information.
 * Supporting the wider team in delivering executive search assignments.




The role combines detailed research with communication, relationship building and commercial judgement. You must be comfortable proactively approaching people, not simply analysing information behind the scenes.




Previous executive search experience is not required. However, applicants are expected to have researched the industry and developed a clear understanding of what executive search involves before applying.




You should be able to explain why executive search interests you, why you would be suited to the work and why you want to build a long-term career within the industry.




What You’ll Do:

Research markets, companies and senior talent

 * Develop a detailed understanding of different industries, businesses, investment markets and leadership structures.
 * Research potential candidate profiles and assess their relevance to specific client assignments.
 * Map target organisations and identify relevant senior executives and leadership teams.
 * Analyse company information, career histories and market activity.
 * Produce clear, accurate market maps and talent intelligence.

Identify and engage potential candidates

 * Proactively identify potential candidates for senior leadership appointments.
 * Support thoughtful and personalised outreach to senior professionals.
 * Contact prospective candidates and help build strong candidate pipelines.
 * Assist in assessing individuals against each client’s commercial, leadership and cultural requirements.
 * Build and maintain professional relationships with high-calibre executives.

Support executive search delivery

 * Work closely with Partners and other senior colleagues across live assignments.
 * Contribute research insights and candidate updates during internal meetings.
 * Support the development of research and candidate-engagement strategies.
 * Recommend new companies, markets or candidate populations to explore.
 * Manage competing priorities while maintaining momentum across multiple assignments.
 * Take increasing ownership of execution work as your capability develops.

Maintain accurate information

 * Keep candidate, company and market information accurate and up to date within internal systems.
 * Produce organised and reliable research that enables senior colleagues to make informed decisions.
 * Handle sensitive and confidential information with care, discretion and professionalism.

Develop your expertise

 * Learn directly from experienced executive search professionals.
 * Observe candidate conversations, client meetings and search-strategy discussions.
 * Develop your commercial knowledge, research skills and professional communication.
 * Build the confidence and judgement needed to progress into an Associate position.




Who We’re Looking For:

You could thrive in this programme if you are:

 * Fluent in German: You have native-level or near-native professional German and can communicate confidently and credibly in a business environment. Having studied German without gaining this level of practical fluency will not be sufficient.
 * Highly ambitious: You are motivated to build a successful career, progress quickly and be recognised for producing excellent work.
 * Intellectually sharp: You absorb complex information quickly, identify patterns and enjoy making sense of unfamiliar businesses and markets.
 * A fast learner: You can develop quickly, respond constructively to feedback and become effective with increasing independence.
 * Genuinely interested in executive search: You understand what the profession involves and can clearly explain why it appeals to you.
 * Commercially curious: You are interested in how businesses grow, compete, raise investment and build successful leadership teams.
 * Research-driven: You enjoy investigating companies, industries and professional backgrounds to uncover relevant information.
 * Confident communicating with people: You are comfortable reaching out to prospective candidates and building professional relationships.
 * An excellent communicator: You express ideas clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, in German and English.
 * Analytical and detail-focused: You can organise information effectively and take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.
 * Resilient: You remain positive and motivated when candidate approaches are unsuccessful or searches become challenging.
 * Proactive: You look for answers, suggest solutions and take ownership rather than waiting to be directed.
 * Collaborative: You contribute positively to a team and support colleagues when deadlines are tight.
 * Accountable: You follow through on commitments and maintain consistently high standards.




Your Background:

You may be a final-year student or recent graduate from any academic discipline.

Previous experience in executive search, recruitment, research or another professional environment would be beneficial but is not essential.




It is fine if you have lived, studied or worked outside Germany. However, you must be able to demonstrate native-level or near-native German suitable for professional conversations, written communication and relationship building.




More importantly, you will demonstrate:

 * Strong intellectual capability.
 * Excellent research and communication skills.
 * Native-level or near-native professional German.
 * Strong professional English.
 * Commercial awareness.
 * Attention to detail.
 * Confidence and professionalism.
 * The ability to learn and develop quickly.
 * A clear understanding of executive search.
 * A genuine motivation to build a long-term career within the industry.




Applicants must be:

 * Available to begin the programme on 1 November 2026.
 * Able to accept and sign an offer by 1 October 2026, allowing sufficient time to manage any notice period or existing commitments.
 * Willing and able to work on-site at the company’s Berlin office five days per week following the initial training period.
 * Willing and able to undertake an expected one-month training period in London, subject to final confirmation of the arrangements.
 * Able to communicate in German at a native or near-native professional level.

Candidates who already have the right to work in Germany without employer sponsorship are strongly preferred. As this is a critical hire, exceptional candidates who would require sponsorship may still be considered and should clearly state their work-authorisation position when applying. Sponsorship cannot be guaranteed.




Team Environment:

The successful candidate will join the Berlin office, which is currently Partner-heavy and offers significant exposure to senior colleagues and live client work.

This environment will suit someone who is highly capable, comfortable taking initiative and able to develop rapidly. The successful candidate will be expected to build strong execution skills and become an increasingly valuable contributor to the office.




Equal Opportunities:

Our client is committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where people from all backgrounds are valued and respected.

Applications are welcomed from candidates of all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process and employment.

If you are fluent in German, ambitious, commercially curious and serious about building a successful career in executive search, apply now to be considered for the November 2026 intake in Berlin.

title: Traineeship in International Policy Analysis
description:
General Information

Type of contract Traineeship

Who can apply? EU nationals eligible for our traineeship programme

Grant The trainee grant is €1,170 per month plus an accommodation allowance (see further information section)

Working time Full time

Place of work Frankfurt am Main, Germany

Closing date 20.10.2026

Your team

You will be part of a team in the International Policy Analysis Division of the Directorate General International and European Relations. Our Directorate General has 120 members of staff and prepares policy positions for the ECB, the Eurosystem and the European System of Central Banks on international and European issues (excluding positions on the macroeconomic policies of the euro area and EU Member States).

The International Policy Analysis Division is concerned with issues of systemic relevance to the global economy, global monetary and financial systems, and international financial architecture, covering topics such as global financial markets, commodities, exchange rates, international spillovers and globalisation.

The ECB is an inclusive employer and we strive to reflect the diversity of the population we serve. We encourage you to apply irrespective of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, race, religious beliefs, sexual orientation or other characteristics.

Your role

As a trainee in the International Policy Analysis Division, you will perform one or more of the following tasks:


 * support the work of the Division by, among other things, assisting with data collection and analysis, generating tables and charts, and preparing presentations;
 * maintain and further develop complex databases used to monitor global financial and monetary developments;
 * maintain and further develop quantitative tools and modelling infrastructure;
 * contribute to selected analytical projects by providing research assistance.
   
   

The traineeship offers you excellent opportunities to work closely with highly qualified experts on different tasks and projects in the field of international finance and macroeconomics, giving you valuable experience for a successful professional career. You will be assigned a mentor and will be able to develop your potential and quickly contribute to the work we do. You will be part of a multicultural team that strives for continuous innovation to make a positive impact on the lives of European citizens.

Qualifications, Experience And Skills

Essential:


 * a bachelor’s degree or higher in economics, econometrics, finance, data engineering, data science, applied mathematics or a related field;
 * a sound understanding of international finance, monetary economics, data science or international macroeconomics;
 * experience in collecting data from statistical agencies, public sources or data providers (such as LSEG, Bloomberg, Haver Analytics or other market data services) and/or data analysis;
 * an intermediate knowledge of one or more programming languages and/or econometric software packages (e.g. MATLAB, R, Stata, EViews, Python, SQL or Julia);
 * an advanced knowledge of the MS Office package, in particular Excel;
 * an advanced (C1) command of English and an intermediate (B1) command of at least one other official language of the EU, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages .
   
   

Desired:


 * a master’s degree in economics, econometrics, finance, data engineering, data science, applied mathematics or a related field (or being close to completing a master’s degree);
 * a keen interest in policy-relevant and applied research, together with a proven ability to conduct quantitative analyses;
 * a sound knowledge of statistical and econometric techniques for data analysis.
   
   

You are curious and eager to learn, and want to further develop your ability to analyse complex information. You are keen to collaborate with others, pursue team goals and learn from other people’s diverse perspectives. You strive to know and anticipate stakeholder needs, and will signal any need for change and propose alternative solutions.

You are motivated to contribute to the ECB’s mission, to serve the citizens of the EU as a member of a public institution and to work with colleagues from all over Europe. You are keen to be part of our team and to use your skills and competencies to achieve the aims of this position.

Further information

Initial traineeship of between four and six months, with a possible extension to up to 12 months in total. For some of the positions the starting date will be in the spring of 2027, while for others it will be in the late summer or autumn of 2027.

Other details on the conditions applicable to traineeships at the ECB can be found on our website.

Application and selection process

The recruitment process for this position will include an online interview.

Further information on how to apply is available on our website.

If you are not selected for this position but are still considered suitable, you will be placed on a reserve list for 12 months from the closing date for applications, from which you might be considered for other traineeship positions within the ECB.

title: Global Banking & Markets, Investment Banking, Classic, Technology, Media and Telecom, Munich, Analyst

Job Description

INVESTMENT BANKING

Investment banking works on some of the most complex financial challenges and transactions in the market today. We work with corporations, pension funds, financial sponsors, and governments and are team of strong analytical thinkers, who have a passion for producing out-of-the-box ideas

OUR IMPACT

Our Technology, Media and Telecom (TMT) Group advises clients in the technology, media and telecom sectors on various financial transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, equity and debt financings, joint ventures, restructurings, and financial investments. Key sub-sectors in TMT include software, internet, e-commerce, sports and entertainment, publishing, advertising, broadcasting, cable, wireless, hosting, semiconductors, electronics and hardware

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential

Analysts at Goldman Sachs play an important role in developing and strengthening our client relationships, participating on our advisory teams and in structuring and executing a full range of financial transactions. They gain exposure to the firm's businesses and expand their knowledge of the investment banking industry, as they develop key analytical, communications, marketing and sales skills. Associates develop financial models, perform valuation analyses and are actively involved in mergers and acquisitions transactions and equity and debt issuances. Associates organize and prepare presentations which explain industry trends and assess clients' situations to provide financial advice and recommend strategies to meet client goals. Associates coordinate teams of advisers, attorneys, and bankers for various transactions, lead due diligence processes and actively participate in the negotiations of legal documentation. From maintaining client communication to helping Goldman Sachs structure client transactions, our associates are a vital part of Goldman Sachs' banking teams

ROLE RESPONSIBILITES


 * Develop presentations and reports using industry research, mathematical models and statistical techniques for clients in the TMT sector on topics such as strategic alternatives, capital markets activities, equity positioning and corporate governance
 * Perform comprehensive analyses of financial transactions including pro forma merger scenarios, leveraged buyouts, public listings and financing alternatives using discounted cash flow, sum of the parts, public comparables and precedent transactions analyses
 * Analyze accounting and regulatory statements, debt and equity filings and documents, financial projections and models clients and provide financial and economic advice
 * Support live deal execution in the TMT sector, including due diligence processes, drafting legal documents with lawyers and potential buyers, organizing and attending deal and non-deal roadshows and liaising with other investment banks and parties
 * Support client dialogue by liaising with senior bankers and product experts throughout the firm to address financial, market, or economic problems
 * Interact with client management teams and working groups to execute projects, provide updates and advice
   
   

Skills & Experience We Are Looking For


 * Strong academic record with bachelor's degree and at least 1 year of work experience or MBA degree with relevant experience
 * Significant investment banking experience required (experience in the Technology / TMT sector preferred)
 * Experience with buy-side and sell-side M&A, equity and debt financing transactions required
 * Experience with due-diligence and transaction execution processes required
 * Strong financial modelling skills required
 * Financial valuation experience with knowledge of DCF, LBO, merger modeling, comparable companies, and precedent transactions required
 * Experience preparing and maintaining industry / company presentations and benchmarking materials and other process documents required
 * Strong team orientation and demonstrated ability to work effectively with team members in multiple groups and regions
 * Capacity to interact and build relationships with a wide range of people and act as a point of contact
 * Excellent communication and presentation skills
 * Excellent work ethic, motivation level, and attention to detail
 * Personal integrity, initiative and leadership qualities
 * Ability to develop into a senior TMT investment banking professional

description:
About Us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a true startup Operations person. Good onboarding is what makes our merchants set up for success. From the first meeting, the go-live to working and growing together - this person will own the onboarding process and make it all happen. This role is for someone who likes working with the product, becoming an expert in it and teaching others.

Your day-to-day will be a mix of hands-on ops, project management, customer communication and problem solving. We are reshaping the future of hospitality tech, and this role is at the forefront of it.

What You’ll Do:

Our Operations happen on a restaurant floor, in a lively neighbourhood, at a busy bar - we operate in the city:


 * Run restaurant onboarding: train, connect and implement together with the restaurant team
 * Problem-solve for our merchants on the ground while running live operations
 * Support restaurants for the first month after the go live
 * Find opportunities for improvement in our process, materials and systems
 * Identify product and process gaps and bring it to internal central teams such as product, engineering and central operations

 * You are a creative problem solver who enjoys interacting with hospitality businesses
 * You are empathetic towards our merchants and curious about their business

 * Good communication - you are great at proactive contact and managing expectations

 * Flexibility in working hours to fit our merchants’ needs

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/de/careers.

Benefits:


 * Start-up Equity
 * Competitive Salary
 * Flexible Time-off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How We Use AI At Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

As a Junior System Administrator, you’ll help maintain the health and reliability of products and infrastructure in a monitoring-focused operational environment. You’ll respond to a high volume of alerts, investigate issues using monitoring tools, and resolve or escalate incidents according to established procedures. The role offers hands-on exposure to Linux and Windows environments, as well as monitoring platforms such as Grafana and Zabbix. You’ll work alongside primary and senior duty administrators and contribute to incident response when critical issues arise. After onboarding, you’ll take ownership of primary duty shifts while collaborating with a distributed international team. This is a strong opportunity to deepen your systems administration and monitoring expertise in a structured, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities


 * Monitor the health and performance of products and infrastructure, responding to approximately 150–250 alerts during a typical shift.

title: Intern Corporate Finance
description:
Your role

Cloover runs three business models at once: a lending book, a payments product, and an energy retailer, each with a completely different capital profile. Most graduates spend years before they see one of these from the inside, and you will model all three within your first months. Success looks like your logic sitting inside the numbers that go to management and to our investors.

Your mission


 * Build and extend the driver-based Excel models we run the business on, covering commercial forecasts, portfolio projections, and product-level economics, structured so that someone opening them a month later can still follow the logic
 * Produce parts of the forecast the management team plans against, then run the variance analysis that shows where it was wrong and why
 * Build the portfolio views that show how our receivables book is actually performing versus plan, working with vintages, cohorts, amortisation, and loss curves in Qlik
 * Model unit economics across all three products, so we know what a contract earns over its life, how much capital it ties up, and which product returns that capital fastest
 * Contribute to the monthly investor and board packs, and to the answers we give when external parties scrutinise our numbers, where being exactly right matters more than being fast
 * Build the business cases behind a pricing change, a new product, or a new market, and put a number on them that someone will make a decision from
 * Automate recurring analysis and reporting with Claude Code, so work that took four hours the first month takes twenty minutes by the third
   
   

Your profile

We care more about how you think and what you've built than where you've been. Here's what will set you up for success in this role:
